text:
🚨 Según informes, Microsoft canceló las licencias internas de Claude Code después de que la facturación por uso de tokens se volviera demasiado costosa.

💡 Y eso llama la atención porque Microsoft ya invirtió US$13 mil millones en OpenAI y sigue impulsando gran parte de la infraestructura de IA con Azure.

⚠️ Pero el punto más importante es otro:
La IA empieza a volverse muy costosa a gran escala.

Según el reporte:
• Uber habría gastado todo su presupuesto de IA para 2026 en solo 4 meses
• los precios del software de IA ya habrían subido entre 20% y 37%
• y GitHub también se mueve hacia precios basados en uso

🤯 La industria está descubriendo que entrenar modelos es caro… pero usarlos masivamente puede ser todavía más costoso.

Fuente: The Verge
notes: Formato típico: emoji titular + 💡 señal clave + bullets + 🤯 takeaway + Fuente. En español.

🔐🤖 Anthropic is using cybersecurity as one of the first serious tests of whether AI agents can handle work that normally takes expert security teams weeks.

💡 The important signal is not just how many bugs Mythos Preview finds… but where it is being tested.

According to reports, the system has already been evaluated across:
• Cloudflare
• Mozilla
• open-source projects
• critical infrastructure systems
• and government-level security environments

⚡ For companies like Cloudflare and Mozilla, faster vulnerability detection means reducing the window before attackers can exploit the same weaknesses.

🤯 And that raises a much bigger question:
If tools like Mythos keep improving, security testing may shift from occasional audits… to constant AI-assisted monitoring.

Source: Anthropic

text:
🏦🤖 Jamie Dimon afirmou que o JPMorgan Chase contratará mais especialistas em IA enquanto reduz algumas funções bancárias tradicionais à medida que a automação avança pela empresa.

💡 Atualmente, o JPMorgan já utiliza IA em áreas como:
• detecção de fraudes
• atendimento ao cliente
• engenharia de software
• pesquisa de mercado
• operações internas

⚡ o que o torna um dos bancos mais avançados na adoção de IA.

A mudança reflete uma nova demanda por profissionais, com maior foco em:
• engenheiros
• infraestrutura de dados
• implementação de IA
e menor necessidade de determinadas funções manuais e repetitivas.

🤯 Segundo Dimon, o objetivo não é simplesmente substituir funcionários, mas aumentar a produtividade e transformar a maneira como o trabalho é realizado dentro da organização.

Fonte: Bloomberg
notes: En portugués. Demuestra que Darwin publica en múltiples idiomas según la audiencia.

text:
🧠⚡ Mira Murati's new bet is not about making AI sound smarter
It's about fixing the awkward pause that happens when:
you ask something → wait → correct the answer → repeat.

💡 That tiny gap is why AI still feels clumsy during real collaborative work.
Especially in:
• brainstorming
• coding
• teaching
• planning with teams

🚀 Her new company, Thinking Machines, is trying to make AI keep up with real conversations in real time.
Conversations where people:
⚡ interrupt
⚡ change direction
⚡ think out loud

🤯 The goal isn't just better answers… it's making AI feel more natural to collaborate with.

Source: Thinking Machines
notes: Usa emojis como bullets (⚡ interrupt). Apertura con contraste: 'no es X... es Y'. Muy efectivo.

text:
⚡️🏠 NVIDIA wants to turn homes and buildings into part of a massive AI network
The company partnered with Span to develop XFRA nodes:
small AI computing units installed outside homes or businesses.

💡 The idea:
use extra electricity from local grids
to create distributed AI computing power.

🚀 Instead of relying only on giant data centers…
thousands of connected nodes could work together
like a decentralized AI infrastructure.

🤯 Your neighborhood could literally become part of the AI cloud.

Source: Inc.

text:
🚀🤖 OpenAI is expanding Codex beyond traditional software development, introducing new tools designed for business professionals and knowledge workers.

💡 According to OpenAI, Codex now has more than 5 million weekly users.
And one statistic stands out:
📈 Non-developers account for roughly 20% of the user base and are growing more than three times faster than developers.

⚡ OpenAI also introduced six specialized plugins for:
• data analytics
• creative production
• sales
• product design
• public equity investing
• investment banking

Together, these plugins connect with 62 widely used applications and provide more than 110 specialized skills.

🤯 The signal is clear:
AI coding tools are evolving into broader workplace assistants that can support a wide range of professional tasks.

The rollout is currently available in preview for Business and Enterprise teams.
Source: OpenAI

text:
🚀💻 Chris Pavlovski says Rumble is preparing to compete directly with AI hyperscalers such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

💡 The effort is tied to Rumble's planned acquisition of Northern Data, which would add thousands of NVIDIA GPUs and significant data center capacity to its infrastructure network.

⚡ Reports suggest the deal could provide access to more than 22,000 NVIDIA H100 and H200 AI chips across multiple facilities.

🤖 Pavlovski says the company wants to build AI infrastructure around privacy and freedom-first principles, positioning Rumble Cloud as a full-stack AI compute provider rather than just a video platform.

🔥 The message is clear:
The AI race is no longer only about models and software.
Increasingly, success depends on access to GPUs, electricity, cooling systems, data centers, and cloud capacity.

📷 Source: Chris Pavlovski / X
notes: Darwin News Instagram. Cierra con 'The message is clear:' seguido de insight en 2-3 líneas cortas.

text:
💻🤖 Anthropic is training Claude Code in a different way.
According to a report from Business Insider, the company is using feedback from around 1,000 software engineers to improve its coding assistant.

💡 The work is reportedly being done through Snorkel AI's Marlin project, where specialists compare outputs from different models and evaluate which code is more:
• correct
• secure
• reliable
• maintainable

⚡ The report says some contractors were paid $280 per task, with each task taking roughly an hour.

🤯 The bigger signal is clear:
AI training is becoming increasingly dependent on expert human knowledge and judgment.

Source: Business Insider
notes: Darwin News Instagram. Apertura con giro inesperado ('in a different way'). Datos específicos ($280/tarea).
